name: Sharelet – Social Share Buttons
author: minosh

sections.description:
Sharelet adds clean, fast social sharing buttons to your WordPress posts and pages. No tracking scripts, no external requests on page load, no subscriptions.

Most social share plugins load 100KB+ of JS and CSS. Sharelet’s free plugin loads zero JS and minimal CSS. Only if you use the Copy Link button (premium add-on), it loads an extra 347 bytes of JS. No jQuery, no bloat, no tracking scripts.

Free Features:
– Facebook, Twitter (X), Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, and WhatsApp share buttons
– Choose which networks to show
– Place buttons above, below, or both sides of content
– Shortcode support for manual placement
– Works on posts and pages

Premium Add-on (one-time $19):
– Copy Link button
– Email share button
– No subscription, no renewals, pay once use forever

Support

Please open a support thread on the WordPress.org support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sharelet-social-share-buttons/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings, Sharelet Social Share to configure
  4. Choose which networks to display and set button position
  5. Optional: purchase and install the premium add-on to unlock Copy Link and Email buttons
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes. Facebook, Twitter (X), Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, and WhatsApp buttons are completely free. Copy Link and Email require a one-time $19 premium add-on.

Do I need a subscription?

No. The premium add-on is a one-time payment. No renewals ever.

How do I get the premium add-on?

From https://sharelet.minosh.me/ – you get the premium add-on file instantly after purchase. Install it alongside the free plugin and the premium buttons show up automatically. No license key needed.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The free plugin loads zero JS and minimal CSS. Only the Copy Link button (premium add-on) loads an extra 347 bytes of JS. No external scripts, no tracking.

Can I place buttons manually?

Yes. Use the shortcode [shrlt] anywhere. To show specific networks: [shrlt networks=”facebook,twitter,pinterest,bluesky,threads,whatsapp”]

How many buttons should I show?

4-5 is the sweet spot. More than that and they start wrapping to a second row. Stick to the networks your audience actually uses.
